column1: # boru Language Specification: the boru:parse module (custom parsers)
# Format: input<TAB>expected<TAB>description
# boru:parse lets a boru author DEFINE a parser and register it as a `parse`
# kind (boru:parselang). A grammar is built from an ABNF source (Parse.abnf),
# declarative rules (Parse.rule, shaped by the Parse.RuleSpec / Parse.AltSpec
# Map subtypes), fixed tokens (Parse.token) and custom lex matchers
# (Parse.matcher); semantic actions (Parse.action) attach boru fns to grammar
# marks so the parser can emit custom data. Parse.grammar mints the builder;
# Parse.parser finalizes it into a ParseLang Function VALUE. The carrier is a
# shared pointer threaded through each word and bound to a def; the finalized
# parser is def-bound and run via the `parse` value form (`parse <name> …`).
# §1  ABNF grammar + a mark action — the action's boru value is the result

import "boru:parse"  import "boru:parselang"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.action g '@op:o:INC' ([nd:Any] => [7])  Parse.abnf g 'op = "inc" / "dec"' {start:'op'}  def op (Parse.parser g)  end  parse op 'inc'
column3: Parse.grammar + Parse.action + Parse.abnf + Parse.parser: action value is the AST

column1: import "boru:parse"  import "boru:parselang"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.action g '@op:o:INC' ([nd:Any] => [{k:'inc'}])  Parse.abnf g 'op = "inc" / "dec"' {start:'op'}  def opm (Parse.parser g)  end  (parse opm 'inc').k
column3: an action can build a custom Map node that survives to the parse result

column1: # §2  tokens, a declining matcher, and a declarative rule coexist with ABNF

import "boru:parse"  import "boru:parselang"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.token g '#PL' '+'  Parse.matcher g skip 1000000 ([s:String] => [None])  Parse.rule g extra {open:[{s:'#PL'}]}  Parse.action g '@op:o:INC' ([nd:Any] => [5])  Parse.abnf g 'op = "inc"' {start:'op'}  def op2 (Parse.parser g)  end  parse op2 'inc'
column3: Parse.token, a declining Parse.matcher and a declarative Parse.rule build alongside the ABNF grammar

column1: # §3  the grammar-as-Map-subtypes type exports
import "boru:parse"  import "boru:parselang"  typeof Parse.AltSpec
column3: Parse.AltSpec is a Map subtype describing one grammar alternate

column1: import "boru:parse"  import "boru:parselang"  typeof Parse.RuleSpec
column3: Parse.RuleSpec is a Map subtype describing a rule's open/close alternates

column1: # §4  loud failures (negative coverage)
import "boru:parse"  import "boru:parselang"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.abnf g '= = bad ='  def broke (Parse.parser g)
column3: a malformed ABNF grammar is a loud error at register, not a panic

column1: import "boru:parse"  import "boru:parselang"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.action g 'noat' ([nd:Any] => [1])
column3: an action ref must start with '@' (a mark/phase selector)

column1: import "boru:parse"  import "boru:parselang"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.abnf g 'x = "a"' {start:'x'}  def p (Parse.parser g)  def p2 (Parse.parser g)
column3: a finalized grammar is single-use — a second Parse.parser is declined

column1: # §5  Parse.spec — the WHOLE grammar as one declarative map, mirroring the
#     tabnas GrammarSpec document: {options rule ref v} plus the boru
#     extension sections abnf and matcher. options is the tabnas OptionsMap
#     (fixed:{token:…} declares fixed tokens, rule:{start:…} the start rule)
#     and applies FIRST, as tabnas does; ref is the named-action table
#     (serving ABNF marks and rule-alt a:'@name' references); rule is the
#     GrammarRuleSpec shape. Everything defers to Parse.parser, so the map
#     form is equivalent to — and composes with — the chained builder words.

import "boru:parse"  import "boru:parselang"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.spec g {ref:{'@op:o:INC': ([nd:Any] => [7])} abnf:{src:'op = "inc" / "dec"' start:'op'}}  def sp1 (Parse.parser g)  end  parse sp1 'inc'
column3: the §1 grammar as ONE map — ref + abnf sections

column1: import "boru:parse"  import "boru:parselang"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.spec g {options:{fixed:{token:{'#PL':'+'}}} rule:{extra:{open:[{s:'#PL'}]}} ref:{'@op:o:INC': ([nd:Any] => [5])} abnf:{src:'op = "inc"' start:'op'}}  def sp2 (Parse.parser g)  end  parse sp2 'inc'
column3: the §2 grammar as one map — fixed tokens are tabnas OPTIONS (options.fixed.token), exactly as in a serialized tabnas grammar

column1: import "boru:parse"  import "boru:parselang"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.spec g {options:{rule:{start:'top'}} rule:{top:{open:[{s:'#TX' a:([nd:Any] => ['got'])}]}}}  def sp3 (Parse.parser g)  end  parse sp3 'hello'
column3: a FULLY declarative grammar — options.rule.start + rules, no ABNF at all

column1: import "boru:parse"  import "boru:parselang"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.spec g {options:{rule:{start:'top'}} ref:{'@w': ([nd:Any] => ['via-ref'])} rule:{top:{open:[{s:'#TX' a:'@w'}]}}}  def sp4 (Parse.parser g)  end  parse sp4 'hello'
column3: a rule-alt a:'@name' reference resolves through the ref section — tabnas Ref-table semantics

column1: import "boru:parse"  import "boru:parselang"  def f1 ([nd:Any] => [3])  def f2 ([nd:Any] => [nd add 4])  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.spec g {ref:{'@op:o:INC': [f1/v f2/v]} abnf:{src:'op = "inc"' start:'op'}}  def sp5 (Parse.parser g)  end  parse sp5 'inc'
column3: a ref LIST runs in order, each fn seeing the previous one's node (/v keeps the fns inert in the list)

column1: import "boru:parse"  import "boru:parselang"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.spec g {abnf:[{src:'op = "inc" / "dec"' start:'op'}]}  Parse.action g '@op:o:INC' ([nd:Any] => [9])  def sp6 (Parse.parser g)  end  parse sp6 'inc'
column3: the abnf section takes a LIST of entries, and the map form composes with the chained builder words

column1: import "boru:parse"  import "boru:parselang"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.spec g {matcher:{skip:{priority:1000000 fn:([s:String] => [None])}} ref:{'@op:o:INC': ([nd:Any] => [2])} abnf:{src:'op = "inc"' start:'op'}}  def sp7 (Parse.parser g)  end  parse sp7 'inc'
column3: a declining custom matcher rides in the matcher section

column1: import "boru:parse"  import "boru:parselang"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.spec g {v:1 options:{fixed:{token:{'#PL':'+'}}} rule:{extra:{open:[{s:'#PL' c:{'n.dlist':0} u:{tag:'t'} k:{p:'q'} n:{x:1}}]}} ref:{'@op:o:INC': ([nd:Any] => [1])} abnf:{src:'op = "inc"' start:'op'}}  def sp8 (Parse.parser g)  end  parse sp8 'inc'
column3: the v version gate plus the widened alternate fields — declarative condition c (a DOTTED rule-property path: 'n.dlist', never a bare counter name), custom props u/k, counters n — build and register cleanly

column1: # §5  negatives — each malformed section shape is a loud per-section error
import "boru:parse"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.spec g {bogus:{}}
column3: an unknown section key is declined (the tabnas GrammarSpec sections plus abnf/matcher)

column1: import "boru:parse"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.spec g {token:{'#PL':'+'}}

column1: import "boru:parse"  def g Parse.grammar  Parse.spec g {v:99}
